explication: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition system supporting multilingual transcription, translation, and language identification. The main workflow loads a selected model, reads and preprocesses audio, then transcribes it across sliding windows using tokenized autoregressive decoding; optional word timestamps align recognized text to audio. Python callers and the CLI expose the workflow, with the CLI also writing result files. The graph includes documented lower-level decoding and language-detection access. Some connections reflect README-documented behavior; unsampled implementation details are not expanded beyond supported paths.
